about: Shared brush spec for the kolam compiler (see docs/hypergraph_kolams.md §8). Language-neutral so a TS port can load the same file.

lattice.gate: lattice point with exactly one odd coordinate: the gap between two 4-adjacent dots, or between a dot and the border
lattice.h_gate: odd row, even col: dots left/right of it
lattice.v_gate: even row, odd col: dots above/below it
lattice.center: even row, even col: empty space between 4 dots; the gate path never visits it

gate_states.about: The curve moves diagonally (dr, dc) = (+-1, +-1) from gate to gate. At each gate the state decides the outgoing direction. Unassigned gates and border gates are SPLIT.

CROSS.meaning: strands pass straight through: an X crossing

JOIN.meaning: mirror along the dot-dot line: strands run parallel around both dots

SPLIT.meaning: wall between the dots: each strand turns back around its own dot

CROSSING_LOOP.order: chain of 4-adjacent dots; repeat the first vertex at the end of a DSL call for a closed ring

PARALLEL_LOOP.order: chain of 4-adjacent dots; repeat the first vertex at the end of a DSL call for a closed ring

HORN.order: HORN(A, dir): one dot A and the direction its tip points, N/E/S/W; sets no gate
HORN.frame: at A's lattice point: fwd = dir, left = fwd turned 90deg counter-clockwise on screen = (-fwd.c, fwd.r)

grow.about: drawing only (docs/hypergraph_kolams.md §10.6). The horn grows out of the drawn line in front of A: points within `half` (arc length) of it are pulled toward the tip T by w = (1 - t)^q, t = arc/half, plus w(1-w)*(open*side_of_point - curl_sign*bend)*left. T = A + reach*(cos(s*curl)*fwd + sin(s*curl)*left), s = +1 LEFT, 0 PLAIN, -1 RIGHT; T is repeated (a sharp tip).

long.when: the spot it points at holds no used dot (empty or off the grid): a crescent whose tip lands on that spot

short.when: it points at a dot some relation uses
